extracted.name: Tomato Barley Soup
extracted.description: This tomato barley soup is a favorite. Onions, celery, carrots, and garlic are cooked with tomatoes in this chicken broth-based soup with barley.
ingredient_lines: 1 (14.5 ounce) can peeled and diced tomatoes with juice
instruction_lines: In a large saucepan over medium heat, combine onions, celery, carrots, garlic, and oil and sauté until all vegetables are almost tender, 5 to 10 minutes.
Add water, fresh tomatoes, canned tomatoes, chicken broth, barley, and black pepper.
Stir thoroughly and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low and simmer until barley is tender, 35 to 40 minutes.
